faq.question: What's included in your parking analytics platform?
faq.answer: Access to real-time dashboards, space usage heatmaps, dynamic pricing tools, automated alerts, and integration options.

faq.question: How does the optimization process work?
faq.answer: We begin with a full audit of your parking data, then implement real-time tracking, identify inefficiencies, and provide actionable insights within 30 days.

faq.question: How quickly can we get started?
faq.answer: Setup takes less than 10 days for most parking facilities (depending on the selected package). Our team handles onboarding, data sync, training, and more.

faq.question: Do I need to use specific hardware or systems?

faq.question: What kind of ROI can I expect?
faq.answer: Most clients see a 15–40% revenue increase from space optimization and better turnover. We back it with transparent performance tracking.

faq.question: How do you measure success?
faq.answer: We track key metrics like revenue per space, occupancy rate, average duration, and underutilization — all visualized in your dashboard.

conversation.q: How can you help me analyze my parkings?
a: I read every facility live: occupancy, revenue, traffic, turnover, rates and incidents.
Ask in plain language and I compare your sites, flag anomalies and tell you what to change.

conversation.q: Show the global overview of all my parkings.
a: 12 sites online. Occupancy 68%, revenue today $41,280, 3 sites at capacity.
Tour CIBC and Central Plateau run 9 points above last month. One site is under-priced in the evening.
Open the south lane 10 minutes earlier, extend the evening cap to 20:00 and move the 18:00 rate to $6.50.

conversation.q: Which parking earned the most this month?
a: Tour CIBC leads with $128,400, up 14% month over month.
Central Plateau follows at $96,100. The gap comes from weekday evening demand.

conversation.q: Schedule a new rate starting at 4 p.m.
a: Done. The $7.00 evening rate applies today from 16:00 at all 12 sites, fixed contracts aside.
Want me to preview the revenue impact before it goes live?

conversation.q: Automate a monthly revenue and occupancy report.
a: Set up. On the 1st of each month at 07:00, I send a PDF and a spreadsheet with revenue, occupancy, average ticket and rate changes per site.
Should I copy your finance team?

conversation.q: Forecast occupancy and traffic for the next 7 days.
a: Rain on Wednesday will shift arrivals 20 minutes earlier. Hold the current rate until Thursday.

conversation.q: Suggest dynamic pricing structures across all my sites.
a: Three fit your data: a base rate with a demand multiplier for offices, event surge pricing near arenas, and a flat weekend cap for retail.
Applied as-is, the model projects +11% revenue and +4 points of occupancy.
